meta.source: apps/web/app/globals.css (Paper direction B), design canvas 6ZjH72YeqmFjUXY6exhNR6, design system v1
meta.note: One theme, Paper. The public site and the studio share it. Filament colors are named fil-* and only ever depict filament.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every surface of the site and studio.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet laid on the paper: the order form, the order summary, dialogs, the proof sheet. Never the page ground.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Tinted paper: the How it works band, side rails, selected chip fill. One tinted band per page at most.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, tiles and quiet buttons on paper or sheet.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside text inputs and textareas, so the field reads as a place to write on the sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders on paper and sheet. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, size cells, dropzone dash). 3.7:1 on sheet, 3.3:1 on paper. Also ruler ticks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and marks on paper, sheet, tint and field. 15.0:1 on paper. Selected borders, the secondary button.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, descriptions, captions on paper, sheet and tint. 7.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Faint text: the Optional tag, helper lines, the typing hint, photo credits. 4.9:1 on paper, 5.7:1 on field, 5.6:1 on sheet; not on tint (4.4:1). Nothing smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: The one accent: the primary button, the current step, the typing caret, the print line in the printing state, the print bed under the logo. Never body text, never a background band, never focus.

tokens.name: brick-press
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and press.

tokens.name: on-brick
tokens.usage: Text on brick. 5.4:1.

tokens.name: brick-wash
tokens.usage: Drag-over fill of the dropzone and the current step marker ring. Never under text longer than a word.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The offset proof shadow under sheets (elev-sheet).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Inline error text and the error border on sheet and paper. 6.9:1 on sheet. Always with words.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Studio status: done, passed. With a word.

tokens.name: run
tokens.usage: Studio status: running. With a word.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Studio status: needs review. With a word.

tokens.name: pause
tokens.usage: Studio status: paused on a cap. With a word.

tokens.name: fil-black
tokens.usage: Black PLA (AMS slot 1). Swatches and filament dots only.

tokens.name: fil-brown
tokens.usage: Brown PLA (slot 2). Swatches and filament dots only.

tokens.name: fil-red
tokens.usage: Red PLA (slot 3). Swatches and filament dots only. Never an error color.

tokens.name: fil-blue
tokens.usage: Blue PLA (slot 4). Swatches and filament dots only. Never a link color.

tokens.name: fil-white
tokens.usage: White PLA (slot 5). Swatches get a line border on paper.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans Variable", "Instrument Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The landing h1 only. 52px under 768px. Fraunces with SOFT 100: font-variation-settings "SOFT" 100, "WONK" 0.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Page titles on inner pages (order, sizes, confirmation). 30px under 768px. SOFT 100.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Product names, dialog titles, the price in the order summary. SOFT 100.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo wordmark only, lowercase, SOFT 0. Never set other words in it.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Send a photo. We print it in up to five colors.
styles.usage: The one paragraph under an h1 or h2. ink-2. 18px under 768px. Max 34em.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A person checks your photos before anything prints.
styles.usage: Running text on the site. Max 65 characters a line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Step titles, summary lines, button labels at md.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, above the field. Sentence case, no colon.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, 15 MB each
styles.usage: Helper lines under fields, card descriptions. ink-2 or ink-3.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Sample photo by Tim Lloyd, CC BY 2.0
styles.usage: Credits, fine print, the Optional tag. ink-3.

styles.name: studio
styles.usage: Studio body text (denser than the site).

styles.name: measure
styles.usage: Real measurements: mm under size letters, dimension lines, ruler numbers, the order reference. Always a number and a unit.

styles.name: measure-s
styles.usage: Ruler tick labels and the quarter or card labels in the size visualizer.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to its tag; icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field; tight stacks; gap between thumbnails.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field to helper line; between size cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between fields in a row; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form rows; card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding on phones; gap between product cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sheet padding on desktop; heading to content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between form sections (Product, Size, Photos, Details).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Heading block to a section's content on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (max width 1440).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photo thumbnails, swatches, the proof sheet corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, size cells, product tiles, the dropzone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets: the order form, the order summary, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the segmented control. Nothing else is a pill.

shadow.note: Sheets get the offset print-proof shadow. Only overlays float. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: elev-sheet
tokens.usage: The order sheet, the confirmation summary, the proof sheet. Offset, hard, no blur.

tokens.name: elev-photo
tokens.usage: Paper photo prints in the How it works trio only.

tokens.name: elev-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers over a scrim.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px sheet gap, then 2px ink. Ink, not brick, so focus never reads as an error. 15:1 on paper.

border.note: Widths. Colors come from line, line-strong and ink.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, card edges, input borders.

tokens.name: border-select
tokens.usage: The selected product tile and size cell (ink), the dropzone dash (line-strong).

duration.note: Motion durations. Everything that moves is transform, opacity or clip-path.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Button press scale.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover color and border changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Size indicator slide, dialog open, price tick.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Heading and paragraph rise on first view.

tokens.name: dur-print
tokens.usage: Print-in of a render when time-based (no scroll timeline).

tokens.name: dur-type
tokens.usage: Typing hint: per character typed.

tokens.name: dur-erase
tokens.usage: Typing hint: per character erased.

tokens.name: dur-hold
tokens.usage: Typing hint: pause on a finished phrase.

easing.note: cubic-bezier values; print-in uses steps so layers land one at a time.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: reveals, dialog open, indicator slide.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving between two places: parallax, price tick.

tokens.name: ease-print
tokens.usage: The print-in clip, so a render builds in 18 visible layers.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Two-column fields (email and phone share a row from here).

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Display sizes step up; nav links appear.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Two-column hero and order section.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Product lineup at full true scale.

tokens.name: bp-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; 72px gutters.
